name: canvas-mcp-svcte
description: Teacher-only Canvas LMS tools for Claude, with 14 built-in teaching workflows: planning, grading, discussions, messaging, peer reviews, analytics, course QC and accessibility.
long_description: Canvas for Teachers lets Claude work in your Canvas LMS courses using your own Canvas access token. It is educator-only (no student tools) and includes 14 built-in teaching workflows (morning check, course QC, accessibility audit, lesson/module/course/assessment planning, quizzes, rubrics, grading, discussions, peer reviews, course copy) that Claude loads automatically; nothing else to install. Student names are replaced with stable pseudonyms (Student 1, Student 2, ...) before anything reaches Claude. Nothing publishes itself: pages, modules, assignments, quizzes and discussions are created as unpublished drafts, and every message to students, discussion post, bulk edit or course copy shows you a preview first and only runs after you approve it. Based on Jaymes Dec's canvas-mcp-node (Franklin School) and Vishal Sachdev's canvas-mcp, both MIT-licensed.

canvas_api_url.title: Canvas URL
canvas_api_url.description: Your school's Canvas address, e.g. https://yourschool.instructure.com (copy it from your browser's address bar when you're logged in to Canvas).

canvas_api_token.title: Canvas access token
canvas_api_token.description: In Canvas: Account → Settings → '+ New Access Token'. Paste it here. It is stored in your computer's keychain and only ever sent to your Canvas address.

allow_deanonymize.title: Allow real student names in Claude's view
allow_deanonymize.description: Leave OFF (recommended). When off, Claude only sees pseudonyms like 'Student 3'; messages you send can still greet students by real name using {first_name}, filled in on your computer. Turn on only for a task that truly needs real names, then turn it back off.

school_config.title: School config file (optional)
school_config.description: Optional JSON file with your school's competency framework and page templates. Leave blank for generic mode. See configs/example.json in the project repo.

enable_code_execution.title: Enable execute_typescript (advanced)
enable_code_execution.description: Lets Claude write and run TypeScript on your computer for very large batch jobs (e.g. grading 100+ submissions). Leave OFF unless you know you need it.
